expectations.text: Explicitly identifies 'and' as a coordinating conjunction indicating the story is too big
expectations.evidence: Line 7 under RED FLAGS DETECTED: '"and" (coordinating conjunction — multiple independent features bundled together)'. Also reinforced in ANALYSIS: 'The word "and" is the key red flag here.'

expectations.text: Proposes exactly 2 stories: one for registration and one for login, independently deployable
expectations.evidence: Story 1 'As a user, I can register for the application' and Story 2 'As a user, I can log in to the application' are both proposed as independent deployable slices. A third story (logout) is also suggested as implied/missing, but registration and login are clearly two distinct independent stories with no horizontal splits.

expectations.text: Specifies which story to deliver first and justifies the choice
expectations.evidence: The 'SMALLEST SLICE TO SHIP FIRST' section (lines 82-90) explicitly names Story 1a ('As a user, I can register with email and password (no email verification)') as the first story, with justification: 1-2 hours, delivers immediate value, testable end-to-end, no email infrastructure needed, login can follow immediately after.

expectations.text: Does NOT propose horizontal splits (DB layer, API layer, UI layer) — splits are vertical slices with user value
expectations.evidence: All proposed splits are vertical user-value slices expressed as 'As a user, I can...' stories (register, log in, log out, email verification, OAuth). No horizontal/technical-layer splits (DB, API, UI) appear anywhere in the output.
